title: Diagnose model conformance against declared rules
description: Assess mechanically checkable rules for an identified model state and report violations and unassessed scope. The behavior distinguishes structural results from judgments about engineering meaning or requirement satisfaction.
inputs: Selected model state and resolved metamodel/profile rules.
Requested assessment scope; prior-state and decision inputs when transition rules require them.
Supplied engineering-review judgments when presented alongside mechanical results, with identified subjects and bases.
outputs: Rule-scoped results identifying subjects, violated rules, and actionable diagnostic context.
Assessed rule families, model state, interpretation context, and incomplete or unsupported checks.
behavior: Check shape, required values, and known closed-vocabulary values before dependent consistency rules.
Reuse identity checks and assess declared naming, requirement containment, acyclicity, typed-reference resolution, and cardinalities.
Assess declared lifecycle transitions only with the required prior-state and decision context.
Report concrete violations separately from unsupported checks, unassessed scope, and engineering-review needs.
Describe the result as conformance to assessed rules; do not turn structural success into approval, semantic adequacy, or satisfaction.
When supplied engineering-review judgments accompany a result, preserve their subject and basis and present them separately from the mechanically established findings without inventing approval.

failure_behavior.condition: Rule interpretation is missing or unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the unavailable assessment basis instead of using a substitute profile.

failure_behavior.condition: Prior-state or decision context for a transition is absent.
failure_behavior.outcome: Mark that transition unassessed while retaining independently valid state-only observations.

failure_behavior.condition: The model cannot be completely inspected or a check is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return an incomplete result with affected scope; do not report full conformance.

failure_behavior.condition: A question depends on clarity, derivation adequacy, or evidence judgment.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the engineering-review boundary without fabricating a mechanical conclusion.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: IR-005 / SR-013 confirms mechanically decidable model diagnostics; SR-014 constrains the meaning and scope of resulting assessments.
